newsitem.title: USA: Port Authority of NY/NJ plan $5 billion spend.
newsitem.headline: Port Authority of NY/NJ plan $5 billion spend.

text.p: Robert Boyle, the Executive Director of the Port Authority of New York and New Jersey, proposed a 5 year capital spending plan totaling $5 billion, the agency said following its monthly Board of Commissioners meeting.

In addition, John F. Kennedy International Air Terminal LLC will spend $1 billion in proceeds from the sale of special project bonds for the redevelopment of Terminal 4, Kennedy Airport's international arrivals building.

Among the projects included in the 5 year plan are a runway extension at Newark International, runway and taxiway improvements at all three New York City area airports, and major bridge painting projects at the George Washington Bridge and Outerbridge Crossing.
